WEBSITE DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT

This Website Development Agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into as of 1 March 2026
(the "Effective Date") between Brightlane Digital Ltd, a company incorporated in England and
Wales ("Agency"), and Harborline Trading Co ("Client").

1. Scope of Services

1.1 The Agency shall design, develop, and deliver a marketing website for the Client, including
up to eight (8) unique page templates, a responsive design for desktop and mobile devices, and
integration with the Client's existing content management system.

1.2 The Agency shall deliver the website within twelve (12) weeks of the Effective Date.

1.3 Any work requested by the Client that falls outside the scope described in clause 1.1 shall
be treated as an additional service. The Agency is not obliged to begin any additional work until
the parties have agreed the additional fees in writing.

1.4 The parties may from time to time agree written amendments to the scope of services. Any
amendment shall take effect only once signed by an authorised representative of each party.

2. Fees and Payment

2.1 The Client shall pay the Agency a total fixed fee of GBP 45,000 (the "Fee") for the services.

2.2 The Fee is invoiced in three equal instalments. The first instalment is payable on the
Effective Date, the second on delivery of the design stage, and the third on final launch.

2.3 The Client shall pay each invoice within thirty (30) days of the invoice date.

2.4 Invoices are exclusive of value added tax, which shall be added at the prevailing rate.

2.5 The Agency may charge interest on overdue amounts at 4% above the Bank of England base rate,
accruing daily from the due date until payment is received in full.

2.6 Fees for additional services are payable within thirty (30) days of the Agency's invoice.

3. Intellectual Property

3.1 On payment in full of the Fee, the Agency assigns to the Client all intellectual property
rights in the deliverables created specifically for the Client under this Agreement, excluding
the background materials described in clause 3.2.

3.2 The Agency retains ownership of its pre-existing materials, tools, libraries, and know-how,
including any generic code, design patterns, and internal frameworks used to produce the
deliverables ("Agency Materials"). The Agency grants the Client a perpetual, non-exclusive,
royalty-free, worldwide licence to use, copy, and modify the Agency Materials to the extent they
are embedded in or required for the operation of the deliverables.

3.3 Third-party fonts, images, and stock photography remain subject to their original licence
terms. The Agency shall identify in writing each such item that is licensed on a non-transferable
basis, and the Client shall be responsible for obtaining any extended licence it requires.

4. Client Obligations

4.1 The Client shall provide the Agency with timely access to the personnel, materials, and
approvals reasonably required to perform the services. Where the Agency's delivery timetable is
delayed by the Client's failure to provide any required input, the Agency may extend the timetable
by the period of the delay without further charge.

4.2 The Client shall appoint a single point of contact who is authorised to provide approvals and
instructions on behalf of the Client. The Agency is entitled to rely on any instruction given by
the named contact as a binding instruction of the Client.

4.3 The Client warrants that it holds all rights necessary to supply the materials it provides to
the Agency, and that such materials do not infringe the rights of any third party.

5. Warranties and Liability

5.1 The Agency warrants that the services will be performed with reasonable skill and care.

5.2 The Agency does not warrant that the website will achieve any particular volume of traffic,
revenue, ranking, or commercial result.

5.3 The Agency's aggregate liability under this Agreement is limited to the greater of the total
fees paid by the Client in the six (6) months preceding the claim or GBP 100,000.

5.4 Neither party is liable for loss of profit, loss of business, loss of anticipated savings, or
any indirect or consequential loss, in each case whether or not foreseeable.

5.5 The limitations in clauses 5.3 and 5.4 do not apply to fraud, fraudulent misrepresentation,
death or personal injury caused by negligence, or any other liability that cannot lawfully be
limited.

6. Term and Termination

6.1 This Agreement commences on the Effective Date and continues until all services have been
delivered and the Fee has been paid in full.

6.2 The Client may terminate this Agreement on thirty (30) days written notice. The Agency may
terminate this Agreement on thirty (30) days written notice if the Client fails to pay any
invoice and does not cure the failure within fifteen (15) days of written notice of the
non-payment.

6.3 On termination the Client shall pay for all work performed up to the date of termination,
including work in progress and any non-cancellable third-party commitments.

6.4 Termination does not affect any rights or liabilities that have accrued before termination.

6.5 Clauses 3, 5, 7, and 8 survive termination of this Agreement.

7. Confidentiality

7.1 Each party shall keep confidential all information disclosed to it by the other party that is
marked as confidential or that ought reasonably to be treated as confidential.

7.2 The obligations in clause 7.1 do not apply to information that is or becomes public through no
fault of the receiving party, was already known to the receiving party, or is independently
developed without use of the disclosing party's information.

8. Governing Law

8.1 This Agreement is governed by the laws of England and Wales, and the parties submit to the
exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of England and Wales.

9. Dispute Resolution

9.1 The parties shall attempt in good faith to resolve any dispute by negotiation between named
senior representatives within thirty (30) days of written notice of the dispute.

9.2 Either party may commence proceedings in respect of a dispute at any time.

10. Entire Agreement

10.1 This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the parties and supersedes all prior
drafts, proposals, and understandings relating to its subject matter.

10.2 No variation of this Agreement is effective unless in writing and signed by both parties.

SIGNED for and on behalf of the Agency: ____________________
SIGNED for and on behalf of the Client: ____________________
